annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes paid OneCoin-related packages by claiming that mining tokens and splits can double an investment, while offering upgrades with additional splits and automatic mining. It directs viewers to contact an inviter or register through a signup destination and says members can benefit by joining early. annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is a paid package bundling tokens for obtaining OneCoins, with splits explicitly claimed to double investment value. Although the presenter calls the purchased product academy education and the tokens free, the promoted participation benefit is acquiring more coins and increasing their investment value. The value slide also presents appreciation as a projection, not an achieved or guaranteed result. Payment for education is explicitly evidenced: the presenter says the actual purchase is an academy level providing cryptocurrency education. The package slide supplies advertised package prices, while the same education bundle provides tokens for the promoted mining and investment opportunity. This is not inferred solely from the word academy or from an investment amount. A separate package-linked Coin Safe arrangement involves placing mined coins into the service for two years and receiving interest, compared by the presenter to a savings account. This supports a passive holding/deposit-return mechanism without establishing any particular interest rate or payout.
